mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_key = 'student' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' )
mapper.select:
select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.status, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.dept_type from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where u.del_flag = '0' and
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
and (d.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors))
and (d.dept_id = #{params.schoolId} or find_in_set(#{params.schoolId}, d.ancestors))
and u.status = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from sys_dept parent join sys_dept college on college.dept_id = case when parent.dept_type = 'MAJOR' then parent.parent_id else parent.dept_id end join sys_dept school on school.dept_id = college.parent_id where parent.dept_id = d.parent_id and d.dept_type = 'CLASS' and d.status = '0' and parent.del_flag = '0' and parent.status = '0' and college.del_flag = '0' and college.status = '0' and (college.dept_type = 'COLLEGE' or (college.dept_type is null and (trim(college.dept_name) like '%学院' or trim(college.dept_name) like '%系'))) and school.parent_id = 0 and school.del_flag = '0' and school.status = '0' and (school.dept_type = 'SCHOOL' or school.dept_type is null) )
${params.dataScope} order by u.user_id
mapper.update: update sys_user u set dept_id = #{toId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.dept_id = #{fromId} and u.del_flag = '0' and and u.status = '0'

update sys_user u set dept_id = #{deptId}, nick_name = #{nickName}, phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, email = #{email}, sex = #{sex}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and
update sys_user u set status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
